messages:
maya: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR with the new trace->dashboard mapping examples and an updated Node SDK snippet. Also fixed one broken metrics v1 link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :sparkles:
sam: nice. can you paste the Node snippet inline here? i want to verify we use the new client API (no legacy sendTrace call).
maya: sure, quick copy from the PR:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.tracing.attach({
  traceId: trace.id,
  spanName: 'dashboard.ingest',
});
```
joel: small nit: the client method in SDK v0.9 is `client.tracing.attachSpan(...)` in Node. the PR sample will break for anyone on 0.9. we should either match published SDK or add a note for v0.9->v1 migration.
maya: good catch — i can update to show both variants with a short migration note. do we want full code block for the v0.9->v1 mapping?
olga: yes please. also check metric names in the dashboard JSON we added — we mapped `inference.latency.p50` -> `latency.p50` in the example, but telemetry prefers full-ns names like `redwood.inference.latency.p50`. otherwise alerts won't match.
maya: ok i'll change metric names to `redwood.inference.latency.p50` and `redwood.inference.requests` in the dashboard schema example.
linda: can we add a screenshot of the dashboard widget (top-right panel) and call out which field maps to `trace_id`? PMs keep asking where to click.
maya: will add a screenshot and a one-line caption. where should i upload it? repo assets or shared drive?
sam: repo assets is best (docs/static/images). please follow the existing naming conventions.
deploy-bot: CI passed — docs build succeeded for branch patch/obs-snippet-migration (link: https://ci.internal.redwood/1234) :white_check_mark:
joel: also leave a brief changelog entry in the PR description: "Telemetry mapping: metric names normalized; Node SDK snippet added with migration note". that'll help release notes.
maya: added changelog blurb. final blockers?
olga: lgtm from telemetry after metric rename.
sam: lgtm from eng-platform if the snippet covers both SDK versions.
linda: approved for console docs side — please include the screenshot and a short troubleshooting tip about missing traces (common cause: trace_id not propagated).
maya: perfect. I'll update the PR now and request reviews from @joel and @olga. thanks everyone :pray:
